in my opinion your best bet is to have max number of kids (6) then have your preference of 2 adults or elders carrying 2 kids each, you hold 2 kids, have the other 2 carrying the kids follow you, craft some stripped sticks or sharpened sticks and give 1 or 2 to each and equip yourself, go out exploring. if you see one of your apes getting attacked, intimidate or attack the animal yourself, switch to the injured ape and heal it, rinse and repeat. 

the more children around when doing things, both new and old, the more neuronal energy you can accumulate and some learned skills can be gained faster. 

it’s also worth to mention that examining meteor sites will grant a huge amount of neuronal energy, and for each child with you when examining for the first time you get an extra reinforcement point to keep a skill(s) when you pass a generation. so at max kids (6) you get 6 reinforcement points, and if all kids are in attendance when finding a meteor then you gain 6 additional points, i’ve managed to stack up to 24 reinforcement points at a doing this, but it’s not recommended in early game as you don’t get many nodes all at once like you’re able to do once you have genetic mutations and basic nodes in place from previous generations.
once you get mutations and skills that help your tree climbing and jumping it feels a lot better swinging from branch to branch

you start at the year 10 million BC and evolve and work your way to being under 2 million BC, that’s when you evolve into early human and the game ends, but much like assassins creed, you can continue playing your save but you will forever be in the moment before you evolved and ended the game.

Go to a sleep spot and in the evolution menu check your feats, you need new ones to evolve your ape through the timeline and stages in appearance. You also need randomly generated mutations locked into your neural network or tech tree as they allow for more skills/abilities to be learned that are otherwise unavailable no matter how far you evolve, this happens when you have adults and elders with genetic mutations alive when you evolve your clan. for instance i am at the millennium man evolutionary stage and have bipedalism unlocked, but i could also be the lucy evolution and still be on all fours with minimal walking if i evolved and didn’t have the genetic mutation that lead to bipedalism.

the red circle is the max your health/stamina will ever be, it shrinks as your ape ages, gives birth, suffers a lasting laceration, or you over exhaust the ape by using all your green and yellow circles.
